entities.name: Q54QM0 TIM22
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and 100% coverage) to reviewed Dictyostelium discoideum mitochondrial import inner membrane translocase subunit TIM22.
Annotated as an essential core component and channel-forming subunit of the mitochondrial TIM22 complex.
Annotated localization is the mitochondrial inner membrane; multi-pass membrane protein.
Length is 179 aa; estimated molecular weight 19,474 Da; theoretical pI 7.67.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved, supporting a transporter/structural rather than enzymatic role.

entities.name: TIM22 complex
observations: Mitochondrial inner-membrane translocase complex that inserts multi-pass transmembrane proteins.
TIM22 forms a voltage-activated, signal-gated channel and uses the mitochondrial membrane potential as driving force.

entities.name: Mitochondrial protein insertion
observations: The protein is annotated in the process of inserting multi-pass proteins into the mitochondrial inner membrane.
